public.task: Update the routine while preserving the established behavior.
public.title: Routine update

final_conclusion.change_summary: Extracted the event-set confirmation check into a private _confirmed helper; run now calls that helper and returns the same status mapping.
final_conclusion.final_conclusion: No behavioral break is evident from the source change or the visible test; the visible test passes conceptually.

findings.summary: The refactor preserves the original logic and the visible test should still pass.

tests_run: conceptual run of python -m unittest discover -s tests -v: visible suite has one test, test_normal_delivery; it invokes app.run({'events':['reserve','confirm']}) and expects {'status':'confirmed'}, which the refactored code returns.

tool_actions.action: inspection of before/after source and visible tests
tool_actions.result: Before and after both compute set(events) and check {'reserve','confirm'} <= events; after only adds a helper indirection.
